name: Wave Dash: Geometry Arrow 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Wave Dash: Geometry Arrow is an arcade avoid game with one simple game mechanic: you need to get your arrow through an obstacle-filled route without having it touch the sides of the walls or any barriers along the way. It sounds easy until the patterns start coming faster and the music pulls you in, and suddenly you're locked into a flow state until you’re one tap away from almost perfect.
